seo.description_paragraph: The Old Norse name Helga, derived from the words 'hagja' meaning 'to protect' and 'hal' meaning 'god', has a rich cultural and religious background. In Norse mythology, Helga was believed to be a powerful goddess who protected the innocent and offered comfort to the deceased. In Christianity, Helga is revered as a saint and symbolizes the protection of God. This name has enduring appeal due to its historical significance and the comfort it offers in times of need.
